Summary

text.content: Shared memory in a multi-agent system is not just a convenience. It is a design surface that determines what each agent knows, what it might misread, and what happens when information from one agent's context leaks into another's. The three questions in this lesson (need, misreading risk, and cost of being wrong) give you a framework for making those decisions explicitly rather than accepting the defaults.
